address.zh: 桃園市中壢區中和路139號
address.en: No. 139, Zhonghe Rd., Zhongli Dist., Taoyuan City

getting_there.zh: 在校內任一公車站搭 132 或 133 往中壢，車程約 20–30 分鐘。132 的終點是中壢公車站，下車後步行即可到火車站。
getting_there.en: Take bus 132 or 133 from any stop on campus towards Zhongli; the ride takes about 20–30 minutes. Route 132 ends at Zhongli Bus Station, a short walk from the train station.

sources: https://www.phy.ncu.edu.tw/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/附件2-1120831國立中央大學對外交通資訊-事務組英文版NCU-Transit-Information-1.pdf

getting_there.zh: 在校內搭 172 或 173 直達高鐵桃園站，車程約 15–20 分鐘。回程在高鐵站公車站 8 號月台搭車。
getting_there.en: Take bus 172 or 173 from campus straight to THSR Taoyuan Station; the ride takes about 15–20 minutes. Coming back, board at platform 8 of the station's bus terminal.

sources: https://www.phy.ncu.edu.tw/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/附件2-1120831國立中央大學對外交通資訊-事務組英文版NCU-Transit-Information-1.pdf

getting_there.zh: 先搭 172 或 173 到高鐵桃園站，再轉乘機場捷運到機場。
getting_there.en: Take bus 172 or 173 to THSR Taoyuan Station, then change to the Taoyuan Airport MRT for the airport.

sources: https://www.phy.ncu.edu.tw/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/附件2-1120831國立中央大學對外交通資訊-事務組英文版NCU-Transit-Information-1.pdf

name.en: National Immigration Agency, Taoyuan City Service Center (ARC)

address.zh: 桃園市桃園區縣府路106號1樓
address.en: 1F, No. 106, Xianfu Rd., Taoyuan Dist., Taoyuan City 330026

hours.zh: 週一至週五 08:00–17:00，中午不休息

getting_there.zh: 這個服務站在桃園區，不在中壢。先搭 132 或 133 到中壢火車站，轉乘台鐵到桃園火車站，再依地圖前往。
getting_there.en: This office is in Taoyuan District, not Zhongli. Take bus 132 or 133 to Zhongli Train Station, ride a TRA train to Taoyuan Station, then follow the map for the last stretch.

name.en: National Health Insurance Administration, Northern Division

address.zh: 桃園市中壢區中山東路3段525號
address.en: No. 525, Sec. 3, Zhongshan E. Rd., Zhongli Dist., Taoyuan City 320216

getting_there.zh: 位於中壢區，請依地圖規劃路線。
getting_there.en: The office is in Zhongli District; follow the map for a route.
